title: Joining Joe Oliver at the Lincoln Gardens
summary: After playing with Dutrey, Shoffner joins Oliver at the Lincoln Gardens, then follows him toward the Plantation Cafe while Lee Collins takes his place.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Well that's what fate wanted me to come over. Well see by me playing that way that's where I come to know all those fellas and get their style because see when they come to like playing shows or hard music, they'd all the time say well Bob you take the lead trumpet. You can read it right off. Well I can read it well but then by playing beside them that's where I come to get the whole style. And of course I liked that style and was brought up with it. Well then I came up back in Chicago in 22 after leaving Charlie, that's when Dutre was going in the Lincoln Garden because Joala was out on the coast. That's when Dutre got me to come in his band with him. And we went to work in the Lincoln Garden about six months until Joala was coming back. And when Joala came back to go to Lincoln Garden Joala was signing me up to quit Dutre to go to work with him. And that's when I went in the Lincoln Garden to work with him and when we was working together until Dave Payton, Joala was after the Plantation Cafe. Well last day Dave was a ranger, he had more. Yes I knew him too. Yeah you know more musical of the prestige than Jo, you see. Was he in the theaters that he worked at the director of the orchestra at that time? In the Grand Theaters. In the Grand Theaters. So what did he tell you? He told you, alright then I'll sign the contract for you. But when you sign the contract he signed it in Dave Payton's band with Jo Oliver appearing. Yeah. Well then Jo worked in there for about six minutes and then he's sitting and told me, he said well you go and keep my band at Lincoln Garden. That's when I got her and he got her, at least I didn't get her, he got her, Lee Collins and worked with me.

So Lee worked with you too. Worked with me. Because I knew Lee. He had a practice while Jo was in, while Jo was up in the plantation. Yeah. Well then, after Jo realized what he was doing in the plantation, Jo switched and had me to leave the Lincoln Garden and go up to the plantation.
